Fix parent 06ea24954efa0fe6f1cac5d87046f9b54dac2dcc TwoDimensionalArrayFormatter.Deserialize (and 3D/4D siblings) in src/MessagePack/Formatters/MultiDimensionalArrayFormatter.cs reads attacker-controlled iLength/jLength via MessagePackReader.ReadInt32, then maxLen via ReadArrayHeader, then immediately executes new T[iLength, jLength] with no product/header consistency check.

At the same parent, MessagePackReader.ReadArrayHeader (src/MessagePack/MessagePackReader.cs:290-299) bounds the inner element count to remaining payload bytes, while dimension integers used for CLR allocation are not similarly capped. Direct-fix tests in 9b5783a7e40b1281ffce32d8631b9cf4b76b2404 encode 2000x2000 dimensions plus an empty inner array (0x90) under MessagePackSecurity.UntrustedData, proving allocation amplification before rejection.
